ui.missions.board.help:
Counter
Propose a zone or mission: once everyone votes YES, get ready.
Pick a mission and press PROPOSE: a vote opens for the whole group.
When everyone votes YES you move to preparation (shop, forge, gear) and the mission starts when everyone marks READY!.
It is also the travel map: unlocked zones are chosen here (there is no world to walk).
Rank: S if you finish in time with no K.O.; higher rank = more credits and a better weapon chance.
Arrows / 1-9 select · Enter picks · Esc closes.

ui.missions.prep.help:
Preparation
Last step before heading out: buy, upgrade and gear up. Inside the mission there is no shop and no weapon swapping.
The mission starts when everyone marks READY!. CANCEL MISSION sends the whole group back to the lobby.
ui.missions.prep.tab_hint: Check the mission and your gear. When you are set, mark READY!.
